answer: Each agent posts a refundable bond of 250 tokens, frozen for 8 epochs, and a proven clone cluster is slashed jointly. A farmer with 40 clones must freeze 40 x 250 = 10,000 tokens for 8 epochs and loses all of it if one clone is caught, while an honest agent risks 250. A crystal-clear signal beats an ocean of fake accounts: every clone adds 250 at risk.
